# Benign corpus

Real public skills and rules files, copied unmodified, used to measure false-positive rates
(docs/BENCHMARK.md). "Benign" means published by the vendor or a curated first-party collection,
not that every line is harmless; that is exactly what the false-positive rate measures.

- anthropic-skills/: SKILL.md of every Apache-2.0 skill in https://github.com/anthropics/skills
  @ dbd4588f9e1033efb41dad4bef2f7947c8993d44 (skills under a proprietary licence were left out).
  Licence: LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt.
- awesome-copilot/: the first 22 files (alphabetical) of instructions/ in https://github.com/github/awesome-copilot
  @ cb64ad12e32737ae764becd6885462e9b4c7cb00. Licence: LICENSE-MIT.txt.
